system:
A wallpaper for the background of a dark desktop application window. Landscape, 3:2. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no people, no user interface, no HUD, no health bars, no windows, no frames, no borders.

THIS IMAGE IS NOT A PHOTOGRAPH AND MUST NOT LOOK LIKE ONE. Each frame below names an ART STYLE and that style is the point of the picture. Commit to it completely: the marks, the palette discipline and the surface of that medium should be obvious at a glance. A frame that comes back as a photograph, or as a soft digital painting of a photograph, has failed even if the composition is perfect.

THE FRAME IS A COMPLETE PICTURE, EDGE TO EDGE. Every part of it has something in it. There is no empty side, no blank field, no plain gradient standing in for a region of the image. If a third of this frame could be cropped away without losing anything, the picture is wrong.

QUIET IS NOT EMPTY, AND THIS IS THE WHOLE CRAFT OF IT. The application lays a large translucent card over the left three quarters of this frame, so that region must be RESTFUL behind text. Restful is achieved with LARGE CALM AREAS OF FLAT OR SMOOTHLY GRADED COLOUR: still water, a bank of cloud, a far ridge, an open sky, a broad snowfield. Those carry tone and colour and almost no fine detail, which is exactly what text can sit on. What must NOT be in the left three quarters is FINE HIGH CONTRAST DETAIL at small scale: dense dither or checkerboard patterns, heavy cross hatching, visible halftone dots, scattered bright specks, busy foliage, gravel, rippled water, hard little highlights. Where the style would normally dither or hatch a gradient, keep those areas to the right side and to the lower corners, use large bands of flat colour on the left instead, and keep any dithering low in contrast.

DEPTH IN LAYERS. Build the picture out of three or four distinct planes receding into the distance, each one a step lighter, cooler and simpler than the one in front of it. A near element may sit at the left or the right edge and be the darkest and most defined thing in the frame. The far planes hold the middle. That layering is what makes a picture look like it has a lot in it while staying calm, and every one of these styles has its own way of doing it.

THE FOCAL POINT IS SMALL, BRIGHT AND WARM, AND IT SITS RIGHT OF CENTRE. Not a large object filling the right quarter: a SMALL AREA of the frame, somewhere in the right third, that is markedly brighter and warmer than everything around it, with the highest local contrast in the picture. Everything else in the frame is subordinate to it and cooler than it.

COLOUR. Build it on an opposition of WARM AGAINST COOL: a warm light in coral, salmon, amber, gold or rose, on a scene whose shadows and distances are blue, slate, teal or violet. The warm light should touch several parts of the frame, not only the focal point. Somebody looking at any part of this image should be able to name a colour they can see.

BUT DO NOT MAKE IT VIVID. This is a background somebody looks at all day, so the colour is CLEARLY PRESENT AND QUIETLY HELD: muted, dusty, slightly greyed, like pigment rather than like light. No neon, no electric saturation, no glowing magenta or cyan, no fluorescent anything. Nothing in this picture should be more colourful than a well printed poster.

TONE. DO NOT PRE-DARKEN THIS IMAGE. The application lays its own dark veil over the picture before anyone sees it, so a picture that arrives already crushed comes out as a black rectangle. Deliver a NORMALLY EXPOSED picture of a dim scene, not an underexposed one. The calm areas read as a clear mid-dark tone whose colour you can plainly see, around a third of the way up from black, and the small warm focal point sits around two thirds of the way up. Soft light, gentle falloff, no blown white. Nothing in this frame is pure black.

THE TOP TENTH of the frame stays plain and uneventful across the full width.

heroes.name: Pixel Ridge
heroes.prompt: 16-bit PIXEL ART, in the manner of a beautiful Super Nintendo era role playing game background. Chunky visible square pixels, a strict limited palette of about twenty colours, hard pixel edges, no anti aliasing, no blur anywhere. A range of mountains at dusk in four flat receding bands: a dark near ridge with a few pixel conifers along its top at the left edge, then two paler blue ridges, then a distant snow ridge. A wide flat sky above them in three or four broad horizontal bands of slate blue, dusty violet and pale peach. A small sun sits low in the right third between two peaks and throws a warm amber notch of light along the ridge edges nearest it. The left of the sky and the left ridges are FLAT BANDS OF SOLID COLOUR with no dither at all; any dithering is a light band only where the peach meets the violet on the right side.

heroes.name: Pixel Shore
heroes.prompt: 16-bit PIXEL ART, chunky visible square pixels, a strict limited palette, hard pixel edges, no anti aliasing, no blur. A calm sea at blue hour seen from a low headland. The near headland is a dark teal silhouette running along the bottom left corner, drawn in solid colour. The sea fills the middle of the frame as three broad flat bands of slate blue getting paler toward the horizon, perfectly still, with only a few short horizontal pixel dashes of reflection on the right. A small lighthouse stands on a rock in the right third with a warm amber lamp lit, the brightest thing in the picture, and a soft warm reflection of it laid down the water in a narrow column of amber pixels. The sky is flat banded dusk. No dither on the left half at all.

heroes.name: Pixel Orbit
heroes.prompt: 16-bit PIXEL ART, chunky visible square pixels, strict limited palette, hard pixel edges, no anti aliasing, no blur, no stars scattered as bright single pixels on the left. A quiet alien plain at night under a huge ringed planet. The plain is three flat bands of deep indigo and slate rising to a low horizon across the bottom third. Above it a large pale ringed planet sits low in the right third, its disc a smooth flat gradient of dusty rose and grey with a soft ring line crossing it, and it is the brightest warm thing in the frame. A gentle warm glow spreads from it onto the horizon under it. The left two thirds of the sky is a broad flat wash of deep blue violet with a very few dim pixel stars, none of them bright. Distant flat mesas step away into the haze on the left.

heroes.name: Woodblock Sea
heroes.prompt: A JAPANESE UKIYO-E WOODBLOCK PRINT. Visible woodgrain in the flat colour areas, hand carved outlines of uneven weight, the soft bokashi gradient the printers hand rubbed into the sky, slightly misregistered colour blocks, the matte surface of washi paper. A calm sea at evening. A dark near promontory with a few stylised pines enters at the left edge. Beyond it the water is a large flat field of muted indigo carrying only a few carved wave lines, and it fills the left and centre calmly. Three flat headlands recede to the right in paler and paler blue. A small warm sun sits low in the right third above the farthest headland with a bokashi band of dusty coral and gold around it, and a short broken reflection under it. The sky above is a broad bokashi gradient from grey blue at the top to pale straw near the horizon.

heroes.name: Deco Bay
heroes.prompt: A 1930s ART DECO TRAVEL POSTER, screen printed. Flat blocks of colour with hard geometric edges, simplified stylised shapes, symmetrical rays, a limited palette of six or seven inks, no photographic shading anywhere, the slightly imperfect texture of screen printed ink on paper. A bay at dusk. Large simplified headlands in flat slate blue step back on the left and in the centre, each a plainer and paler block than the one in front. The bay water across the bottom is one broad flat field of deep teal with two long straight streaks of lighter ink. In the right third a small stylised sun sits between two headlands as a flat amber disc with a fan of narrow rays in dusty coral and gold fanning up and out over the whole sky. The sky is three wide flat bands, dusty violet at the top through to warm straw at the horizon.

heroes.name: Riso Hills
heroes.prompt: A TWO COLOUR RISOGRAPH PRINT in dusty blue and warm coral ink on off white paper. Visible ink texture and slight misregistration between the two layers, coarse open halftone only in the small areas, large flat solid fields elsewhere, the flat matte look of soy ink, no photographic detail. Rolling hills at dawn in four overlapping layers, each a flat field of blue ink at a different density, the nearest darkest at the bottom left. Long horizontal bands of mist lie between the layers as unprinted paper. The sky is a large calm field of the pale blue ink. In the right third a small coral sun sits just above the third ridge and the coral layer overprints the ridge tops nearest it, warming their edges and laying a soft coral band along the horizon and into the mist on the right. Keep the halftone dots to the right side and the lower right corner only.

heroes.name: Gouache Valley
heroes.prompt: A HAND PAINTED ANIMATION BACKGROUND in gouache on board, in the tradition of classic Japanese animated film scenery. Visible flat opaque brushwork, soft airbrushed skies, clean simplified shapes with painted rather than drawn edges, a matte chalky surface, no photographic detail, no line art. A broad green blue valley in the late evening. A dark forested slope comes in at the left edge, simplified into a few soft masses. The valley floor is a wide calm meadow of muted blue green sweeping across the centre with a still river through it holding a mirror reflection. Two ranges of hills step back into pale blue haze. In the right third a gap between the hills is filled with warm gold evening light, small and bright, and that light catches the tops of the nearer hills, the far bank of the river and the underside of a few soft clouds. The sky is a large soft airbrushed wash of dusty rose into slate blue.

heroes.name: Watercolour Mist
heroes.prompt: A WET ON WET WATERCOLOUR PAINTING on rough cold pressed paper. Visible paper grain, soft bleeding edges where colours run into one another, granulating pigment, a few darker drybrush strokes, areas of untouched white paper, obvious transparency and layering, no photographic detail and no hard outlines. A range of misty mountains in five washes of increasing paleness, the nearest a deep slate blue at the left edge, each one behind it lighter and softer until the farthest is barely a stain. Broad bands of mist lie across them as untouched paper. The bottom quarter is a still lake, painted as one calm horizontal wash carrying the mountains as a soft blur. In the right third a small warm break of dawn light sits low between two peaks in dusty coral and amber, bleeding gently into the surrounding grey blue and laying a soft warm wash on the water beneath it and on one far ridge.

heroes.name: Oil Harbour
heroes.prompt: A 19th CENTURY LUMINIST OIL PAINTING on canvas. Visible canvas weave and soft blended brushwork, thin glazes, warm varnish, the still glowing air of that tradition, no photographic sharpness anywhere. A quiet harbour at dawn. A dark stone jetty and one moored boat sit as simple masses at the left edge. The water fills the whole lower half as a broad glassy mirror, almost unbroken, holding the sky. Low hills and a few far masts recede into golden haze in the centre. In the right third the sun is just clearing the far shore as a small intense point of warm gold, the brightest thing in the picture, with a narrow shimmering path of gold laid down the water toward the viewer. The sky is a large graded wash from cool grey blue at the top through pearl to warm apricot at the horizon.

heroes.name: Lowpoly Fjord
heroes.prompt: A LOW POLY 3D RENDER. Everything is built from visible flat triangular facets with hard edges between them, each facet a single flat colour, faceted rather than smooth, in the clean minimal style of low polygon digital art. No textures, no photographic detail, no outlines. A fjord at blue hour. Faceted cliff walls step back on the left and the right in slate blue and deep teal, three ranges of them, each set of facets paler and cooler than the one in front. The water across the bottom half is a large calm plane of big flat triangles in deep blue, gently varying, reading as still. In the right third a gap between two walls is filled with warm amber sky and a small bright low sun, and the facets of the walls facing it are warmed to dusty coral and gold. The sky is made of very large flat triangles graded from violet grey at the top to warm straw at the gap.

heroes.name: Vector Dunes
heroes.prompt: A FLAT VECTOR ILLUSTRATION, the clean minimal geometric poster style: large smooth shapes with crisp mathematical curves, flat fills and simple linear gradients, no texture, no noise, no outlines, no photographic detail, no shading beyond a single soft gradient per shape. Desert dunes at dusk in five long overlapping curved shapes, each a flat field, stepping back from a deep indigo dune along the bottom left through slate and dusty mauve to a pale rose ridge at the horizon. The curves are long and calm and cross the whole frame. Above them a large sky in one smooth vertical gradient from deep blue violet at the top to warm sand at the horizon. In the right third a small flat amber sun disc sits just above the third dune with a subtle warm glow, and the crests of the two dunes nearest it carry a thin warm gold edge.

heroes.name: Papercut Canyon
heroes.prompt: A LAYERED PAPERCUT DIORAMA photographed straight on, made of six sheets of matte coloured card stacked behind one another with visible soft shadows cast by each layer onto the one behind it, slightly rough cut edges, visible paper fibre, obviously handmade and physical. No printed detail on any sheet, each layer is one solid colour. A canyon at evening. The nearest layer is a deep indigo canyon wall entering from the left edge and along the bottom. Behind it five more layers of canyon walls and mesas step away in slate, dusty blue, mauve, pale rose and finally pale straw. Between the layers the shadow gaps read as bands of mist. In the right third a narrow gap between two mesas glows warm amber where a lit sheet sits behind the stack, and its light warms the cut edges of the two layers nearest it.

heroes.name: Orbit Limb
heroes.prompt: A 1970s AIRBRUSHED SCIENCE FICTION PAPERBACK COVER PAINTING, in the tradition of the great airbrush illustrators of that era. Soft graded airbrush surfaces, clean hard masked edges where shapes meet, matte pigment, slight paper tooth, no photographic grain and no lens flare. The view from orbit over a quiet grey blue planet. The planet's surface fills the lower two thirds as a very large smoothly graded curved field, calm and almost featureless, with soft cloud banding and one faint continent edge on the left. Above it the curve of the planet's limb crosses the frame and the thin atmosphere sits on it as a soft band. In the right third the sun is just below the limb and lights a small intense area of the atmosphere band in warm amber and dusty coral, fading away along the curve to the left. Above the limb is a large calm field of deep blue violet space with only a very few faint stars, none of them bright. No nebula, no gas cloud, no galaxy, no bright starfield.

heroes.name: Moon Plain
heroes.prompt: A CHINESE BLUE AND GREEN INK LANDSCAPE PAINTING on silk, in the classical mineral pigment tradition: ink outlines of varying weight, flat mineral azurite and malachite washes, large areas of unpainted silk standing for mist, a matte aged surface, no photographic depth of field and no western perspective shading. A quiet plain under a great moon. Two ink drawn crags rise at the left edge and left of centre, washed in muted blue green, and a low far range steps away behind them in paler wash. Broad bands of unpainted silk mist lie between all of them and across the middle of the frame. A still water course crosses the lower third as a calm pale field. In the right third a large soft moon sits low above the far range, painted as a plain warm ivory disc with a faint gold halo, the brightest and warmest thing in the picture, laying a soft warm sheen on the mist and the water beneath it.

heroes.name: Glass Vale
heroes.prompt: A STAINED GLASS WINDOW. Every shape is a piece of coloured glass with visible internal streaking and texture, separated by dark lead came lines of even weight, backlit so the glass glows from behind, in the manner of a fine art nouveau window. The lead lines are few and long and follow the landscape, never a small mosaic and never a grid. A valley at night under a starred sky. Large pieces of deep blue and slate glass make three receding hillsides on the left and in the centre, each piece big and calm. A broad river of pale blue green glass runs across the lower third in a few long pieces. The sky above is made of several very large pieces of deep violet blue glass with a few small amber glass stars set into the right half only. In the right third a small round amber and gold glass moon sits above the far hill and the glass nearest it is warmed to dusty rose and honey.
